target.title: fix(google): bound batch create error body read
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`response.text()` in the Gemini batch create non-404 error path embeds the
full response body in the Error message.

## Why This Change Was Made

Replaced raw `response.text()` + `throw Error` with `createProviderHttpError`
for non-404 errors. Preserves 404 diagnostic message. Pattern from #102953.

## User Impact

**Before:** unbounded body in error message
**After:** bounded + redacted via `createProviderHttpError`

## Evidence

### Loopback proof

`assertOkOrThrowProviderError` → `ProviderHttpError` with redacted metadata:
```
Status: 400 | Redacted: PASS | No JSON keys: PASS | Structured code: PASS
```

### Tests

```
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/google/embedding-batch.test.ts
Test Files  1 passed (1)
```

### Diff

```
extensions/google/embedding-batch.ts | 3 +-- (createProviderHttpError)
```

- [x] I understand what the code does
- [x] Change is focused and does not mix unrelated concerns
